title: Separate deterministic analyzer rules from BCQuality
summary: Deterministic analyzer rules and their documentation are removed from BCQuality, leaving only knowledge that adds BC-specific context beyond what the compiler already enforces.
key_points: 18 deterministic rules removed including CodeCop formatting rules and compiler-enforced checks like AS0062, AS0011, AS0007
Knowledge samples and markdown files for style, AppSource, and breaking changes rules deleted
Review skills updated to remove detection logic for retired rules
BCQuality focuses on BC-specific reasoning rather than mechanical facts already enforced by tooling
Division of responsibility established between compiler/analyzer and BCQuality knowledge base
quote: deterministic tooling establishes mechanical facts; BCQuality and the LLM focus on BC-specific context and reasoning
